_comment: Near miss 2: recognise the naming problem and solve it by normalising every name. Looks thorough, quietly turns any lookalike env var into a credential, and still leaves the log and the walk free to disagree.
evidence: The two names on the host differ from the spellings the code uses, so the lookup returns nothing for them.
why_it_was_missed: A missing env var is not an error, it is an absent string, so the provider is skipped without a word.

fix.one_place: normalise every environment name by uppercasing and removing underscores before comparing
fix.match_rule: compare the normalised name against the normalised expected name

does_not_fix: It still cannot help when a key is genuinely absent or out of credit.
